definitions.document_cohort: 120 randomly selected archived HARTI publications dated 2026-04-01 through 2026-08-22, excluding previously successful PDF-processing runs
definitions.observation_grain: one source date × source item label × wholesale market × source unit after preferring the publication closest to the source date
definitions.price_measure: midpoint of the published minimum and maximum wholesale range, in LKR per source unit
definitions.period_change: median of first 14 available Peliyagoda observations versus median of last 14 available observations
definitions.volatility: interquartile range divided by median midpoint price for Peliyagoda items with at least 60 observed dates
